summary: The diff is a small, additive, non-regressive UI fix: it wires `homeThreadSlot={<HomeThreadSlot />}` into the already-present `AppShellFrame`/`homeRoute` setup, adds a new `HomeThreadSlot.tsx` that mirrors the Discuss conversation inline on the dashboard route, hoists `HOME_ROUTE` into shared context, and suppresses `VeriComposer`'s duplicate inline discuss preview there. I independently verified the underlying premise correction (AppHeader/header/homeThreadSlot already exist in veridian-ui-kit, no version bump needed), confirmed `AppShellFrame`'s real prop signature (`homeRoute` required, already passed unchanged from layout.tsx) and `ThreadView`/`ThreadMessage` types line up exactly with what `HomeThreadSlot.tsx` produces, and reran `npx tsc --noEmit` myself (exit 0), matching the self-report. No security, auth, schema, or workflow-file changes; blast radius is limited to two client components in one Next.js app. One real but non-blocking gap: the fix only wires the Discuss thread into `homeThreadSlot` — Query and Conversation threads (`activeQueryId`/`activeConversationId`) remain panel-only, so if a user opens one on a non-Home page and then navigates to `/dashboard` without closing it, `AppShellFrame`'s own `isHome` branch still hides the panel and nothing in the main content area shows that thread (composer collapses to just a 'Back' button). This is pre-existing behavior, not a regression introduced by this diff, and it partially fixes rather than fully closes the 'opening a thread on dashboard shows nothing' gap PROGRESS.md itself identified — but PROGRESS.md's Remaining section checks everything off without flagging this residual gap for follow-up, which understates the real completion state.
issues: Query/Conversation threads (activeQueryId/activeConversationId) still render nothing on the /dashboard route when opened elsewhere and left open while navigating home, since AppShellFrame's isHome branch unconditionally hides the panel and HomeThreadSlot only handles discussMessages -- same class of bug PROGRESS.md's own 'Real gap that did exist' section describes, only partially fixed. Recommend a small follow-up task (either extend HomeThreadSlot to also render the active query/convo, or auto-closeThread() on navigation to HOME_ROUTE).

PROGRESS.md's Remaining section marks the task fully complete (all items checked, no open follow-up noted) despite the residual gap above -- future audits reading PROGRESS.md alone would not know this exists.
